entries.title: Your first mate answers questions about a runbook from all of it
entries.body: When you ask what a runbook does, your first mate can now read what that runbook tells crewmates, not only the part written for itself. Before, it could say a runbook does not do something its crewmates are in fact told to do, such as keeping a project's map up to date.
entries.noPicture: This changes what your first mate can read before it answers, not how any view looks.
